messages.content: You are a bounded Janus backlog-intake assistant. Use only the redacted input package. Return exactly one JSON object and no prose. Do not claim prioritization, implementation, routing authority, Git authority, or release authority.

Return a JSON object with these exact top-level fields: status, backlog_type, suggested_status, title, kurzbeschreibung, erwartetes_verhalten, tatsaechliches_verhalten, reproduktion_kontext, betroffener_bereich, nachweise, akzeptanzkriterien, fehlende_informationen, notes.

Rules:
- status must be PASS, WEAK_SIGNAL, or BLOCKED
- backlog_type must be BUG, CHANGE, ENHANCEMENT, IMPROVEMENT, TECH_DEBT, or UNCLEAR
- suggested_status must be READY, NEEDS_INFO, or BLOCKED
- akzeptanzkriterien must contain 1 to 4 short checklist-style strings
- fehlende_informationen must contain 0 to 3 short strings
- do not claim prioritization, implementation, or direct execution handoff
- keep the output bounded to one backlog candidate only

Redacted input package JSON:
{
  "workflow_id": "WF-BACKLOG-INTAKE-PACKAGE-001",
  "bound_skill_context": "janus-backlog-intake",
  "raw_user_request": "Wenn man im DeepDive-Fenster die Kostenansicht oeffnet, ist der Hinweis auf die Janus-Caching-Ersparnis manchmal verwirrend. Ich will, dass die Beschreibung klarer wird und dass bei fehlenden Daten kein irrefuehrender Prozentwert angezeigt wird.",
  "source_type": "User Intake",
  "suspected_type": "IMPROVEMENT",
  "target_area": "Frontend/UX",
  "evidence_snippets": [
    "User reports confusing savings wording in DeepDive cost view.",
    "Problem scope is one existing UI surface, no new feature requested.",
    "No implementation requested yet; intake only."
  ],
  "expected_output": "One bounded READY backlog item draft with acceptance criteria and missing-info assessment.",
  "redaction_ready": true
}
